## Cálculo manual: sumas de cuadrados del ejemplo

<div class="fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="1" style="background-color:#eef4fb; border-left:6px solid #1a3a6b; border-radius:8px; padding:8px 12px; font-size:21px; line-height:1.3;">
<strong class="text-block-blue">Paso 1. Media general:</strong> $\bar y_{...}=24.60$ millones/sucursal, con $a=3$, $b=2$, $n=4$, $N=24$.
</div>

<div class="fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="2" style="background-color:#eef7ee; border-left:6px solid #1b4d2e; border-radius:8px; padding:8px 12px; font-size:21px; line-height:1.3; margin-top:6px;">
<strong class="text-block-green">Paso 2. SC de Estrategia (A):</strong>
$$SC_A=8\big[(23.41-24.60)^2+(26.35-24.60)^2+(24.05-24.60)^2\big]=38.20$$
</div>

<div class="fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="3" style="background-color:#fff7e8; border-left:6px solid #d97706; border-radius:8px; padding:8px 12px; font-size:21px; line-height:1.3; margin-top:6px;">
<strong style="color:#d97706;">Paso 3. SC de Inversión (B):</strong>
$$SC_B=12\big[(21.48-24.60)^2+(27.73-24.60)^2\big]=233.75$$
</div>

<div class="fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="4" style="background-color:#f5f3ff; border-left:6px solid #7c3aed; border-radius:8px; padding:8px 12px; font-size:21px; line-height:1.3; margin-top:6px;">
